description: This file contains JavaScript code for handling form input validation, dynamic text area resizing, and UI interactions in a web application, specifically related to Materialize CSS framework components.

methods.name: updateTextFields
methods.description: Updates the active state of labels and icons based on input value and placeholder.

methods.name: validateField
methods.description: Validates input fields with class 'validate' and updates their valid/invalid classes.

methods.name: textAreaAutoResize
methods.description: Automatically resizes textareas to fit their content.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes auto-resizing for textareas with class 'md-textarea-auto' and sets up event listeners.
